```{r}
# --- figure output redirected to _organized/figures/ ---
# Data files and CSV/RDS outputs keep their original paths.
fig_dir <- "../../../figures/data_analysis/pilot_sensor_matrix"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

folder_path <- "../../project 1_pilot/sensor"

csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Separate output, answer, and data files
output_file <- csv_files[grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files)]
answer_file <- csv_files[grepl("sensor_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]
data_files  <- csv_files[!grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files) &
                         !grepl("sensor_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]

# Read output and answer files
output <- read.csv(output_file, header = TRUE)
cat("output loaded: ", nrow(output), "rows, ", ncol(output), "columns\n")

answer <- read.csv(answer_file, header = TRUE)
cat("answer loaded: ", nrow(answer), "rows, ", ncol(answer), "columns\n")

# Read the remaining files as dat_1, dat_2, ...
for (i in seq_along(data_files)) {
  tryCatch({
    dat <- read.csv(data_files[i], header = TRUE)
    assign(paste0("dat_", i), dat)
    cat(paste0("dat_", i, " loaded: ", basename(data_files[i]),
               " (", nrow(dat), " rows, ", ncol(dat), " columns) \n"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste0("Skip: ", basename(data_files[i]), " -> ", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}
rm(dat)
```

```{r}

  dat <- merge(dat, output[, c("key", "time")],
               by.x = "Video", by.y = "key",

}
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:15) {
  dat_name <- paste0("dat_", i)
  dat <- get(dat_name)

  idx <- match(dat$Video, answer$Video)
```

```{r}
all_cat <- bind_rows(lapply(1:30, function(i) {
  get(paste0("dat_", i))
}))

cat("Merge complete: ", nrow(all_cat), "rows, ", ncol(all_cat), "columns\n")
```

```{r}
# ── Step 1: Build the RT matrix (rows=video, columns=participant) ──────────
rt_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_9.rt) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_9.rt)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = participant,
              values_from = key_resp_9.rt,
              values_fn   = mean)

rt_matrix <- rt_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("RT matrix dimensions: ", dim(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of videos: ", nrow(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of participants: ", ncol(rt_matrix), "\n")

# Check missing values
cat("Number of missing values: ", sum(is.na(rt_matrix)), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ── Step 2: Compute by column z-score ──────────────────────────
rt_zscored <- scale(rt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# ── Step 3: Run PCA ───────────────────────────────────
pca_rt <- prcomp(rt_zscored, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# ── Step 4: Inspect explained variance ──────────────────────────────
var_explained <- summary(pca_rt)$importance
cat("=== Variance explained by each PC ===\n")
print(round(var_explained[, 1:10], 3))

# Find the number of PCs needed to explain 80% and 90% of the variance
cum_var <- cumsum(pca_rt$sdev^2 / sum(pca_rt$sdev^2))
k_80 <- which(cum_var >= 0.80)[1]
k_90 <- which(cum_var >= 0.90)[1]
cat("\nExplaining 80% of the variance requires ", k_80, " PC\n")
cat("Explaining 90% of the variance requires ", k_90, " PC\n")

# ── Step 5: Visualize explained variance ───────────────────────────
plot(cum_var, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of PCs",
     ylab = "Cumulative Variance Explained",
     main = "Sensorimotor - RT PCA")
abline(h = 0.80, col = "blue", lty = 2)
abline(h = 0.90, col = "red",  lty = 2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("80%", "90%"),
       col    = c("blue", "red"),
       lty    = 2)

# ── Step 6: Scores for each video on each PC ──────────────
pc_scores <- pca_rt$x
cat("\n=== Video PC scores (first 5 rows and first 5 PCs) ===\n")
print(round(pc_scores[1:5, 1:5], 3))

# ── Step 7: Videos with the highest and lowest scores on each PC ────────────
cat("\n=== Highest- and lowest-scoring videos for each PC ===\n")
for (k in 1:k_90) {
  scores <- pc_scores[, k]
  top3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
  bot3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:3]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  highest: ", paste(top3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  lowest: ", paste(bot3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```
PC1 explains 12.1% of the variance, lower than in CAT and VoE.
Explaining 80% of the variance requires 14 PCs.
Explaining 90% of the variance requires 18 PCs.

```{r}
# ── Save PC scores (retain the first 14 PCs, which explain 80% of the variance) ──────────
save_path <- "."

pc_scores_80 <- as.data.frame(pc_scores[, 1:k_80])
pc_scores_80$Video <- rownames(pc_scores)
pc_scores_80 <- pc_scores_80 %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

pc_scores_90 <- as.data.frame(pc_scores[, 1:k_90])
pc_scores_90$Video <- rownames(pc_scores)
pc_scores_90 <- pc_scores_90 %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

# Export
write.csv(pc_scores_80,
          file.path(save_path, "sensor_RT_PCA_scores_80pct.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pc_scores_90,
          file.path(save_path, "sensor_RT_PCA_scores_90pct.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── Save the explained-variance plot ────────────────────────────────────
library(ggplot2)

var_df <- data.frame(
  PC  = 1:length(pca_rt$sdev),
  cum = cumsum(pca_rt$sdev^2 / sum(pca_rt$sdev^2))
)

ggplot(var_df, aes(x = PC, y = cum)) +
  geom_line(color = "#4DBBD5", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "#4DBBD5", size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.90, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = k_80, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = k_90, linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = k_80 + 0.5, y = 0.75,
           label = paste0("80%: k=", k_80), color = "blue", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = k_90 + 0.5, y = 0.85,
           label = paste0("90%: k=", k_90), color = "red", size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Sensorimotor Task - RT PCA Cumulative Variance Explained",
       x = "Number of PCs", y = "Cumulative Variance Explained") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10)

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "sensor_RT_PCA_variance.png"),
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

cat("Complete: PC scores and variance plot saved\n")
```

```{r}
library(logisticPCA)

# ── Step 1: Build the correctness matrix ────────────────────
corr_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_9.corr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_9.corr)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = participant,
              values_from = key_resp_9.corr,
              values_fn   = mean)

corr_matrix <- corr_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Correctness matrix dimensions: ", dim(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of missing values: ", sum(is.na(corr_matrix)), "\n")

# ── Step 2: Select the optimal k by cross-validation ────────────────
logpca_cv <- cv.lpca(corr_matrix, ks = 1:10, ms = 4)
plot(logpca_cv)
k_opt <- which.min(rowMeans(logpca_cv))
cat("optimal k: ", k_opt, "\n")

# ── Step 3: Run logistic PCA ───────────────────────────
logpca_model <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k_opt, m = 4)

# ── Step 4: PC scores for each video ───────────────────────
pc_scores_corr <- logpca_model$PCs
rownames(pc_scores_corr) <- rownames(corr_matrix)

cat("\n=== Highest- and lowest-scoring videos for each PC ===\n")
for (k in 1:k_opt) {
  scores <- pc_scores_corr[, k]
  top3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
  bot3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:3]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  highest: ", paste(top3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  lowest: ", paste(bot3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ── Step 5: Variance explained ──────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== Variance explained ===\n")
var_exp <- logpca_model$prop_deviance_expl
cat("Proportion of Variance explained by each PC: \n")
print(round(var_exp, 3))

# ── Step 6: Save ─────────────────────────────────────
pc_scores_corr_df <- as.data.frame(pc_scores_corr)
pc_scores_corr_df$Video <- rownames(corr_matrix)
pc_scores_corr_df <- pc_scores_corr_df %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

write.csv(pc_scores_corr_df,
          file.path(save_path, "sensor_correctness_logisticPCA_scores.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nComplete: logistic PCA scores saved\n")
```

The cross-validation curve is still decreasing monotonically; k=10 is only the upper bound of the search range.
k=10 explains 86.3% of the variance.
As with CAT, the search range must be expanded to confirm the optimal k.

```{r}
# Expand the k range and rerun cross-validation
logpca_cv2 <- cv.lpca(corr_matrix, ks = 1:20, ms = 4)
plot(logpca_cv2)

# Inspect the elbow location manually
cv_means <- rowMeans(logpca_cv2)
cat("Cross-validation score for each k: \n")
print(round(cv_means, 2))

# Use the elbow rule to find the optimal k
# Calculate changes in slope
diffs <- diff(cv_means)
diffs2 <- diff(diffs)
k_elbow <- which.min(diffs2) + 1
cat("The elbow rule suggests k =", k_elbow, "\n")

# Alternatively, choose the smallest value that reaches 80% explained variance
# Rerun with different k values to inspect explained variance
for (k in c(3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20)) {
  m <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k, m = 4)
  cat(paste0("k=", k, ": Variance explained = ", round(m$prop_deviance_expl, 3), "\n"))
}
```

Recommendation: use k=7. Rationale:

It explains 83.7% of the variance, exceeding the 80% threshold.
It is consistent with CAT (k=7), facilitating cross-task comparison.
The cross-validation curve has a slight bend around k=7-8.

```{r}
# Rerun logistic PCA with k=7
logpca_final <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = 7, m = 4)

cat("Variance explained: ", round(logpca_final$prop_deviance_expl, 3), "\n")

# PC scores
pc_scores_corr_final <- logpca_final$PCs
rownames(pc_scores_corr_final) <- rownames(corr_matrix)

cat("\n=== Highest- and lowest-scoring videos for each PC ===\n")
for (k in 1:7) {
  scores <- pc_scores_corr_final[, k]
  top3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
  bot3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:3]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  highest: ", paste(top3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  lowest: ", paste(bot3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Save
pc_scores_corr_df <- as.data.frame(pc_scores_corr_final)
colnames(pc_scores_corr_df) <- paste0("PC", 1:7)
pc_scores_corr_df$Video <- rownames(corr_matrix)
pc_scores_corr_df <- pc_scores_corr_df %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

write.csv(pc_scores_corr_df,
          file.path(save_path, "sensor_correctness_logisticPCA_k10.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nComplete: k=7 logistic PCA scores saved\n")
```
